traditional: Vitality and authority combined with action and heat.

modern.blend: Identity meets drive and aggression. Energy, assertion, and the will to act become central to the sense of self.
modern.harmonious: Action with little temper behind it. Things get done and the drive feels available rather than volatile.
modern.hard: Rejected aggression gets projected outward or erupts as a short fuse, often with defiance of authority. The energy has to be learned and channeled rather than cut off.
modern.business: Initiative and drive; the cost is friction with authority and a tendency to force things.

cyclicNote: This pair runs a full conjunction-to-conjunction cycle; waxing/waning phase meaning is carried on the transit entries.

provenance.cyclic: applied per-aspect on transit entries (cyclic model)
